policy_title: New Right to Flexible Working and Work from Home for Disabled People
stated: Give everyone a new right to flexible working and every disabled person the right to work from home if they want to, unless there are significant business reasons why it is not possible.

source.quote: Give everyone a new right to flexible working and every disabled person the right to work from home if they want to, unless there are significant business reasons why it is not possible.

bearing_set.reason: Creates a new statutory employment right to flexible working for all workers, directly expanding employment rights, conditions, and job accessibility — earning a real verdict on employment rights and job quality.

The disabled-specific right to work from home is an anti-discrimination/equal treatment measure for a protected characteristic group, directly extending the legal rights framework for disabled people in employment — within O9's equal treatment scope.

membership_note: Two genuine bearings: O4 for the labour-rights and working-conditions effect on all workers, and O9 for the disability equal-treatment dimension. Potential O13 spillover (increased disabled labour-force participation boosting aggregate output) is real but indirect and contested enough that it folds into O4 rather than earning a separate non-negligible verdict. The employer compliance burden is real but bounded by the 'significant business reasons' exception and does not clearly move a specific O12 or O13 indicator beyond the negligible threshold.
